correctness.rationale: The commutator on the central quotient of an extraspecial group is a nondegenerate alternating bilinear form. A symplectic basis gives a paired total dominating set of size \(2n\). If a dominating set spans a proper subspace \(W\), every group element over \(W^\perp\setminus\{0\}\) must itself be selected; counting those forced vertices plus the remaining span dimensions yields at least \(2n\).
